video_note: ffmpeg not installed; screenshots substitute (9 PNGs across all 3 demos)

fix_summary.defect: DelegateCommand (UI-agnostic) could not hook WPF CommandManager.RequerySuggested — bound Undo/Redo buttons never re-queried CanExecute after reset, so IsEnabled stayed False.
fix_summary.remedy: ImageDisplayViewModel.WindowWidth and WindowCenter setters now call RefreshUndoRedoState(), which invokes _undoCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged() and _redoCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged(). Two regression unit tests added; full suite 85 unit+module tests green.

demo_3_t04_undo_redo.notes: All undo/redo interactions succeeded. Previously: UndoButton stuck False after reset, InvokePattern returned 'Unrecognized error'. Now: button enables after reset, Undo/Redo InvokePattern both succeed, WW/WC values correctly cycle through reset -> undo -> redo.
